name: Ice Melts 2: Caribbean Cruise
source:
On the open sea, the line between mission and desire disappears.

Federal agent Jack boards the luxury liner [b]Caribbean Queen[/b] undercover—hunting a smuggling pipeline hidden behind champagne smiles and postcard sunsets.

As the ship cuts through paradise, Jack closes in on three women tied to the investigation: the magnetic Activity Director who knows every secret below deck, the untouchable VIP whose identity doesn't add up, and the shy steward whose fear of authority runs deeper than nerves.

One choice at a glittering cocktail party sets your route—and forces Jack to decide what he's willing to sacrifice when attraction turns the case into something dangerously personal.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4342180/]Steam[/url]]
